info.title: Token economy on the VM side
info.goal: From now on, for every directive: (1) start a fresh agy/agv session per directive, with no chat history carried over from earlier directives; (2) build each prompt with the stable part first (your role, the report/2 rules, repo facts) and the directive last, so the provider's prompt cache is reused between directives; (3) choose Pro or Flash by a rule (no model call just to classify); if you keep a model classifier, report its tokens per tick. In every report/2 from now on, results carry model, input_tokens, output_tokens, cached_tokens, turns and seconds for that directive (null when the CLI does not expose a number; then say in evidence where you looked).
